HPPSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 228 Posts - Complete Details

Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for 228 Medical Officer posts. The online application process will be conducted from 19 September 2026 to 16 October 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, hppsc.hp.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Closing Date for Application : 16.10.2026, 11:59 PM
  • Closing Date for Fee Payment : 16.10.2026, 11:59 PM
  • Examination Station : Shimla
  • Advertisement Date : 19.09.2026
  • Closing Date for Online Application (ORA) : 16.10.2026, 11:59 PM
  • Closing Date for Fee Payment : 16.10.2026, 11:59 PM
  • Cut-off Date for Age & Eligibility : 01.01.2026 (age); closing date of ORA (qualification/experience)
  • Screening Test / Subject Aptitude Test Date : Not specified in the notification; e-admit card to be downloaded from HPPSC website
  • A uniform fee for all candidates, irrespective of category or gender : ₹600

Application Fee

  • Post : Medical Officer (General Wing) (Job Trainee), Group-A
  • Application Fee : ₹600 (uniform for all candidates, irrespective of category/gender)
  • Closing Date for Fee Payment : 16.10.2026, 11:59 PM
  • Examination Station : Shimla
  • Closing Date for Fee Payment : 16.10.2026, 11:59 PM
  • Screening Test / Subject Aptitude Test Date : Not specified in the notification; e-admit card to be downloaded from HPPSC website
  • Personality Test : To be held at the Commission's office, Shimla; date not specified in the notification
  • SC of HP : 19
  • SC of HP (Ex-Servicemen of HP) : 08 (including 05 Backlog)
  • SC of HP (Wards of Freedom Fighters of HP) : 03 (including 02 Backlog)
  • ST of HP : 09
  • ST of HP (Ortho Physically Handicapped of HP) : 04 (including 03 Backlog)
  • ST of HP (Ex-Servicemen of HP) : 03 (including 02 Backlog)
  • OBC of HP : 18
  • OBC of HP (Ex-Servicemen of HP) : 04 (including 03 Backlog)
  • OBC of HP (Wards of Freedom Fighters of HP) : 02 (Backlog)
  • Post : Emoluments
  • Medical Officer (General Wing) (Job Trainee) : ₹34,000 per month (fixed amount, as per the Job Trainee engagement scheme)
  • A uniform fee for all candidates, irrespective of category or gender : ₹600
  • General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh : 30
  • General Knowledge of National and International Affairs : 30
  • Descriptive, syllabus as decided by the Commission : 3 hours
  • Stage : General Category
  • Subject Aptitude Test (SAT) : 45%
  • Personality Test (out of 30 marks) : 40% (12 marks)

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
